To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
green industrial policy and infrastructure plans should be integrated to accelerate a sustainability transformation.
infrastructure obduracy is the main obstacle to the transition to sustainable energy systems, and green industrial policies are an important instrument to overcome this obstacle.

(i) the current approach of separating infrastructure investment and green industrial policies is suboptimal; (ii) the two policy areas are mutually reinforcing and need to be integrated in order to achieve maximum efficiency and impact; (iii) this integration requires a change in the way infrastructure plans and green policies are designed, and a shift from an incremental to an integrated and systemic approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: how can industrial policies be integrated with innovative infrastructure plans, and how can the resulting integrated policy package accelerate a sustainability transition?

the following questions: (a) how can green industrial policies be designed to be more effective and efficient in the transition to sustainability; (b) what is the role of green industrial policy in accelerating sustainability transitions; and (c) how can infrastructure investment plans be designed to accelerate the transition to sustainability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
green industrial policy is a necessary but not sufficient condition to achieve a sustainability transition.
the two policy areas should be combined and that a more holistic approach to the sustainability transition is necessary, in order to achieve a more effective outcome.

the integration of industrial policies with infrastructure plans would accelerate the sustainability transition, but the exact nature of the integration would be dependent on the specific country, sector and context.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a green infrastructure plan can be a powerful lever for green industrial policies, and vice versa.
infrastructure plans should include green industrial policy objectives.
we should not be afraid to integrate infrastructure plans and green policies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a sustainability transition requires both industrial and infrastructure policies to be aligned.
infrastructure plans and green industry policies should be integrated to accelerate a sustainability transformation.
the most efficient way to achieve sustainability is to integrate green infrastructure plans with industrial policy, and to do so by combining the strengths of each.
